attributes.residual: DC'S REVERT IS CONFIRMED CORRECT, AND THE WORK ORDER'S PREMISE THAT THE FRAME-EXACT STATE 'MAY BE THE BETTER PLATFORM' IS NOT SUPPORTED BY EITHER METRIC. Independently re-measured, both states reproduce the published figures to the digit: baseline real 44 / fuzzy 95.9409%; frame-exact (AudioFloatNotZero de-inlined at all 4 sites) real 62 / fuzzy 95.7527%. Both metrics move the SAME way, so the fuzzy-arbitration law does not fire and the AGENTS.md monotonic rule governs - the better verified result is the baseline, and nothing was retained. WHAT THIS PASS ADDS THAT DC'S RECORD DID NOT STATE, and the reason the axis was worth re-opening: the two states differ structurally far more than the 18-point real gap suggests. Baseline slotdiff = 4T/4O exclusive (target 36/56/60 vs ours 52/72/76) but EVERY one of those is exactly +16, i.e. a pure frame-delta shift with no independent slot defect; baseline regnorm = 211 paired, 15 renaming, 3 STRUCTURAL, 18 unpaired, and all THREE STRUCTURAL rows are merely that same displacement (lmw 36 vs 52, lwz 60 vs 76, addi 56 vs 72). Frame-exact slotdiff = SLOT MAP IDENTICAL; frame-exact regnorm = 211 paired, 19 renaming, ZERO STRUCTURAL, 18 unpaired. So the de-inline converts the function from STRUCTURAL-PRESENT to a state with no structural defect at all, whose entire residual is the 18-word entry-schedule permutation plus a register renaming. That is a genuinely cleaner characterisation of the residual - but it is NOT a better platform in any actionable sense, because (a) both retained metrics are worse, (b) DC already closed the prologue-permutation axis at three distinct source shapes all producing byte-identical output, and (c) the 18 unpaired words bar WebFrank candidacy outright. CONCLUSION FOR THE NEXT AGENT: do not re-run the de-inline expecting the fuzzy law to rescue it - it will not, the metrics agree. The function's real residual is a 7-instruction prologue emission order in which target hoists the gPlayers @ha lis ahead of the mulli and interleaves stmw before the @lo addi; that is the only thing left and it has survived four independent source axes across two sessions.
